author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Nana Patekar passed away due to a cardiac arrest at his residence in Goa early Thursday morning. He was declared dead after attempts to revive him were unsuccessful at Manipal Hospital. The Goa Police have registered an 'Unnatural Death' case to investigate the circumstances surrounding his death. A post-mortem examination is being conducted to ascertain the exact cause of death.
title: Nana Patekar death: Goa Police register 'unnatural death' case

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Bryan Cranston transformed a quaint beach bungalow into a stunning net-zero energy residence in Venice, California. The redesigned home showcases sleek modern aesthetics paired with cutting-edge sustainable energy solutions, reflecting eco-conscious principles. Listed in 2021, it achieved an impressive sale of $5.45 million, exceeding its initial purchase price. This remarkable project exemplifies the potential of sustainable living within today’s competitive real estate landscape.
title: Bryan Cranston rebuilt $2.5m bungalow as net-zero home, sold it for $5.45m

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
title: New crocodile species found in rocks used to build Egypt’s Great Sphinx

author: SAURABH SINHA
description: Elon Musk has raised concerns about regulatory obstacles facing Starlink's introduction in India. He claimed influential figures might be hindering the process and questioned if Ambani controls the situation. In response, India's government reaffirmed its fair and non-discriminatory approach, rejecting Musk's allegations. Other companies like Reliance Jio and Eutelsat OneWeb are also vying for approval to offer satellite services.
title: Starlink entry row: Is Ambani the real boss of India, asks Elon Musk

author: RAJ SHEKHAR JHA
description: CBI has obtained evidence related to compromised transfers involving 21 senior officials in Punjab government and police. The probe focuses on a cash-for-postings scam connected to OSD to Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann. Allegations include various requests for administrative favors and transfer requests surrounding certain officers. The investigation involves interactions with individuals linked to tender manipulations across the state.
title: Proof of 21 'compromised transfers', 11 policy changes part of CBI's Punjab file

author: TNN
description: A group of 42 retired judges has expressed concerns over criticism directed at the Election Commission. They stated these attacks serve vested political interests, compromising democratic integrity. The judges defended the EC's actions as essential to maintaining clean electoral rolls for fair elections. They urged political parties to present legit grievances formally, rather than delegitimizing the electoral process.
title: Group of 42 ex-judges defends SIR, slams opposition attack on Election Commission

author: TNN
description: PM Narendra Modi called for a global effort to address cyber frauds and deepfakes at the India Mobile Congress. He highlighted the importance of mobile technology as a tool for governance and effective service delivery. Modi attributed significant financial savings to digital direct benefit transfers in India. He urged collaboration among governments and tech companies to enhance security measures in the telecom sector.
title: Will those whose earnings have stopped love me: PM Modi amid SIR row

author: TNN
description: The GST Council has proposed major procedural changes to enhance business operations and tax compliance. These reforms aim to streamline registration, refunds, and input tax credit processes while lowering compliance costs. Additionally, the council will remove officers' powers for arrests under the GST framework. Processing of refunds will be expedited, with a goal to resolve claims within three days.
title: GST Council scraps tax officers' arrest powers, eases refund rules

author: SENTHIL KUMARAN
description: The community of Perumpalli witnessed blatant discrimination against Dalits seeking to bury their deceased, Senni, in a shared burial ground. As the family attempted to claim the space, Rithuvarman and other non-Dalits impeded their efforts. In a striking moment, two Dalits resorted to begging on their knees for permission. Ultimately, police presence facilitated the burial, preventing further conflict and allowing the family to grieve.
title: TN villagers say they were forced to fall at feet of dominant caste

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Earlier this year, Zach Bryan made headlines by purchasing a sprawling estate in Leiper's Fork, Tennessee, valued at $18.25 million. This stunning property boasts nearly 40 acres of breathtaking views and luxury amenities, including a professional recording studio tailored for his music career. It showcases Bryan's desire for privacy, while still being conveniently located near the vibrant Nashville music scene.
title: Zach Bryan bought $18m Tennessee estate on 146 acres with recording studio

author: SURENDRA SINGH
description: Newly appointed German Ambassador Jasper Wieck met with Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh to discuss defense cooperation. India and Germany aim to strengthen their military and defense-industrial ties, including advanced technologies. The talk follows high-level engagements and a recent agreement on co-development of defense items. Meanwhile, India engages with Greece on maritime security and coastal protection issues.
title: Defence secy talks to German envoy & Greece dy min to widen strategic partnerships

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Votes for five Assembly constituencies and the Nagaon Lok Sabha seat will be counted today. Counting will commence at 8am, with results announced throughout the day. Updates will be provided by the Election Commission of India on their official results website. The Times of India will also provide live coverage of the counting process and results. The counting will occur under security arrangements at the respective counting centres.
title: Bypoll election results: When and where to watch vote counting

author: RUPALI MUKHERJEE
description: The Indian government has announced plans to cap trade margins on all types of cancer drugs. This decision aims to make cancer medications more affordable and accessible, potentially reducing prices by up to 70%. It is expected to result in savings of around Rs 2,500 crore annually for patients. An expert committee will be formed to recommend the list of drugs covered by this initiative.
title: Cancer drug prices may fall as government plans 30% trade margin cap

author: NASEER GANAI
description: Ibra Khan, a student pursuing MBBS at Tehran University, had her passport impounded due to her father's past case. The Jammu & Kashmir High Court intervened, recognizing her completion of half the course before the impounding occurred. Legal representatives argued that Khan could not be held accountable for her father's actions from 1997. A division bench ordered the passport's revival while allowing authorities to impose conditions on its use.
title: J&K: High court orders passport revival for student purusing MBBS in Iran

author: SURENDRA SINGH
description: Indian Air Force celebrated its 94th anniversary at Hindon Air Force Station showcasing its historical significance. The event featured aerobatics by the vintage Tiger Moth and a display of military aircraft. IAF Chief ACM Singh emphasized the importance of operational preparedness and joint operations with the Army and Navy. PM Narendra Modi and Defence Minister Rajnath Singh commended the courage and dedication of IAF personnel.
title: IAF celebrates its 94-year-old glorious journey

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In a shocking turn of events, David J. Rush, a former high-ranking federal employee, has admitted guilt in a case of extensive fraud against the US government. Using his top-secret clearance, he concocted imaginary government projects to pocket nearly $194 million. His lavish spending spree included luxury objects and assets, leading to an FBI raid that uncovered gold bars and cash.
title: US executive admits $193.6m fraud after FBI finds 298 gold bars

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: On Thursday, the United States targeted two Mumbai-based companies over their alleged oil trade involvement with Iran. The sanctions affected five Indian nationals connected to SSPL Solutions Private Limited and Samudra Marine Services Private Limited. These measures are part of a broader crackdown on Iran under 'Operation Economic Outcast'. The U.S. government aims to curb Iranian oil revenues fueling military and cyber activities.
title: US sanctions Indian firms, individuals as Iran oil crackdown widens

author: RENUKA VYAVAHARE
description: "I’m glad I was directed by Nana in Prahaar", said the actress, mourning the loss of the legendary actor.
title: 'He was generous & brutally honest': Dimple Kapadia on Nana Patekar

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Travis Kelce had a quiet game with only two catches but moved past Tim Brown in receptions. The Kansas City Chiefs defeated the Raiders 30-27, improving their record to 4-0. Kelce now sits seven catches away from passing Cris Carter and Marvin Harrison in career receptions. His performance has been overshadowed by strong ground game contributions in this match.
title: Travis Kelce’s NFL resurgence: How is he climbing the record book?

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Walt Disney initiated a secret land acquisition strategy in Florida to develop Walt Disney World. The effort involved purchasing over 27,000 acres through front companies to maintain anonymity. This acquisition began in 1964 and was publicly revealed in 1965. While Disney did not survive to see the completion, his vision ultimately changed entertainment in America. The project included creating the Reedy Creek Improvement District for efficient management of infrastructure.
title: Walt Disney secretly bought 27,000 Florida acres for $5m; it became Disney World

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: In a significant development, over 100 construction workers are about to be compensated in a settlement linked to Caddell Construction due to allegations of labor exploitation at the new US consulate in Milan. Workers endured illegal wage cutbacks, unpaid overtime, and deplorable working environments. Expected payouts will average near 45,000 euros, with select cases reaching an impressive 90,000 euros.
title: Indians among hundreds to get share of $35m payout in labour 'exploitation' case

author: RICHA PINTO
description: A significant incident unfolded on Thursday night when a gas cylinder exploded in a workers' shed at an under-construction building on the IIT Powai campus. Occurring at approximately 10:24 PM in Hostel No. 6, five people sustained injuries—two minors and three adults. Fortunately, all individuals are reported to be in stable condition.
title: 5 injured after gas cylinder explodes at workers’ shed on IIT Bombay campus

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A proposed bill aims to raise penalties against employers violating H-1B visa rules significantly. Introduced by Beth Van Duyne, the legislation is under consideration in the House. Proposed fines would increase from thousands to hundreds of thousands of dollars for serious violations. In addition, the legislation would extend bans on employers from three years to ten years.
title: US bill seeks $250,000 fines, 10-year bans for serious H-1B violations

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: The US has suspended Microsoft from the Permanent Labor Certification Program (PERM), freezing new and pending Green Card applications for its foreign workers. Vice President JD Vance accused Microsoft of abusing the H-1B and PERM system to replace laid-off American workers. Microsoft says 80% of its roughly 6,000 H-1B filings last fiscal year were for existing employees, and that it pays H-1B staff the same as others doing comparable work.
title: US suspends Microsoft from Green Card programme, here is what the company has to say

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: The Indian film industry mourns the loss of Nana Patekar, who succumbed to cardiac arrest as confirmed by his son. The actor's passing, attributed to natural causes, prompted the Maharashtra government to orchestrate a state funeral fitting his legacy in cinema. Tributes poured in from fans and fellow actors in Pune, with many sharing their fond memories of the beloved artist on social media.
title: Nana Patekar cremated with full state honours, fans bid tearful farewell

author: CHIDANAND RAJGHATTA
title: Trump honours CEO Satya Nadella as Vance goes hard at Microsoft

author: PRANJAL PANDEY
description: Palestinian factions are contemplating a delay in the upcoming legislative elections initially set for November 28. This potential postponement is attributed to logistical challenges in Israeli-annexed East Jerusalem and Gaza following the recent war. President Mahmoud Abbas's Fatah party is part of discussions regarding the election timing and national consensus. The European Union has offered to deploy observers for the legislative elections.
title: Palestine factions could postpone elections amid Israeli complications, internal feud

description: A viral  video raises security concerns after a man allegedly removed a chain from a deceased body. The incident occurred at Siwan Model Sadar Hospital, where he approached the body near the registration counter. Following a similar previous complaint, security access to deceased patients is now under scrutiny. Hospital authorities are planning to examine the footage and take legal action if necessary.
title: Bihar: Masked man removes jewellery from dead body, calmly walks away

author: BELLA JAISINGHANI
description: Ratan Tata's pet dog Goa was injured in a car accident outside Bombay House on Thursday. After being given medical attention, Goa is reportedly recovering and shows signs of improvement. Noel Tata visited the injured dog to check on his wellbeing during this time. Goa is expected to participate in the Blessing of Pets ceremony on Sunday, October 11.
title: Ratan Tata’s beloved pet dog 'Goa' survives car accident outside Bombay House

description: In 2019, Metallica's All Within My Hands foundation introduced the Metallica Scholars Initiative, aiming to bolster workforce education. Initially partnering with 10 community colleges, the program has significantly grown, reaching 93 learning institutions nationwide. By 2026, this initiative has seen an investment of over $17 million, enhancing technical education and equipping students for rewarding careers. Additionally, it has successfully introduced a similar program in the UK.

description: The Madras High Court held that the property was not ancestral but self-acquired. As a result, under Hindu law, the man and his mother were legally entitled to execute the gift settlement deed in favour of the man’s second wife, who could subsequently sell the property.
title: Woman claims 2.5 acres was ancestral after stepmother sold it; why HC rejected plea

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Chinese electric vehicles have seen significant growth in the UK market alongside discussions of potential tariff increases. The UK faces pressure to align with EU policies to protect its domestic industries. Meanwhile, Chinese carmakers have established a notable presence, contributing to an expanding market share. British officials are reviewing the impact of Chinese EVs on local businesses and competitive dynamics.
title: US said 'big no' to Chinese EVs, UK welcomed them, now faces 'Made in Europe' fears

author: PALLAVI
description: Rahul Gandhi has weighed in on Elon Musk's comments about the hold-up of Starlink's commercial operations in India. Musk voiced his exasperation over regulatory obstacles, suggesting that oligarchs sway the industry. The government swiftly countered, emphasising the fairness of its regulations among satellite operators and underlining the importance of security compliance for safeguarding users and data alike.
title: 'Welcome to India': Rahul reacts to Musk's remarks; Starlink boss says 'thank you'

author: RAJENDRA SHARMA
description: The Cockroach Janata Party reported that their co-incharge, Deepak Baliyan, was detained by Rajasthan Police. This incident occurred ahead of the planned protest in Delhi against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. While party leaders accused police of forceful detention, the police denied such claims. Protests against Kumar have also been held in Bengaluru by various activists and groups.
title: CJP claims Deepak Baliyan assaulted, brother injured; Rajasthan Police deny action

author: PALLAVI
description: Akhilesh Yadav has urged Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath to contest the upcoming assembly elections from Ayodhya. He indicated plans to visit the Ram temple alongside SP leaders after visiting Kedareshwar Dham in Etawah. Yadav also noted that the BJP has been conducting surveys for the Ayodhya seat, claiming they are struggling to find a candidate to challenge him. This statement responds to BJP allegations about his temple visitations.
title: 'Contest UP polls from Ayodhya': Akhilesh Yadav dares CM Yogi Adityanath

author: KUNAL VARMA
description: Uddhav Thackeray's Shiv Sena has called on AAP and DMK to join opposition forces against CEC Gyanesh Kumar over irregularities in SIR. Despite AAP's separation from the INDIA bloc and DMK's mixed reactions, the lack of participation from both factions underscores existing rifts in the opposition landscape. Analysts argue that these parties might still rally together to uphold democratic principles, though future collaboration remains clouded by their historical rivalries.
title: 'Unite to fight': Uddhav Sena to Kejriwal, Stalin; will AAP, DMK relent?

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Lauren Kyle McDavid's entrepreneurial journey blossomed with her interior design firm, Kyle & Co. However, she initially struggled with the business side of her creativity. To support her, her husband, Connor McDavid, arranged sessions with a business coach. By June 2025, Lauren broadened her horizons, introducing projects like Sports Club Atelier and Trove Living, all while striving to craft meaningful experiences in her diverse portfolio.
title: Connor McDavid’s wife Lauren Kyle: How did she build her five-venture empire?

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A wooden pendant initially bought at auction for under £100 astonished everyone when it fetched an incredible £75,800. Experts identified it as a rare ceremonial ornament from Rapa Nui. Despite its missing head, fierce bidding drove up its value. The buyer, aware of its cultural significance, capitalized on the opportunity, highlighting the intriguing allure of Rapa Nui artefacts in the collectible market.
title: British collector paid under £100 for pendant; it later sold for £75,800

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Nana Patekar, the iconic 75-year-old actor, has sadly died from a cardiac arrest at his residence in Goa. His remains were transported to Donje in Pune, where a state funeral has been arranged to honor his lasting legacy, as announced by Maharashtra’s Cultural Affairs Minister. The scene is expected to attract an influx of filmmakers and politicians who wish to pay their final tributes to the esteemed actor.
title: Nana Patekar’s mortal remains brought to Pune, Maha CM Fadnavis pays last respects

author: NITESH DUBEY
description: The Pakistan Super League (PSL) 12 is scheduled from March 18 to May 2, 2027, aligning with IPL 2027. The Pakistan Cricket Board has confirmed this timeline while maintaining the eight-team format. Notably, last season saw overseas players opted out in favor of IPL contracts, impacting the league's dynamics. In a fresh approach, this season will implement a player auction, enhancing fan engagement and building on last year’s success.
title: PSL to clash with IPL: PCB locks dates; BCCI also eyes early-March start

author: RAJEEV SINGH
description: The bypolls were held on Tuesday, October 6, in Nandigram and Rejinagar in West Bengal, Madurantakam and Dharapuram in Tamil Nadu, Nagaon in Assam and Thattanchavady in Puducherry. Counting of votes in all six constituencies is scheduled for Friday, with the process beginning at 8 am. The results across these six contests, by the end of the day, would  provide more than individual winners and losers.
title: Bengal, Tamil Nadu, Assam and Puducherry brace for closely watched bypoll verdicts

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: The establishment of Great Smoky Mountains National Park was a remarkable achievement that required overcoming significant financial challenges due to increasing land prices. Initial fundraising efforts gathered $5 million, but this amount quickly proved insufficient as prices soared. The Rockefeller family stepped in, matching previous contributions with an additional $5 million, allowing for crucial land acquisitions.
title: Rockefeller fund matched $5m, helping create Great Smoky Mountains National Park

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A California father constructed a 180-foot roller coaster for his son after the child expressed interest. They spent six weeks working on the project, which cost around $3,500 to complete. The father used the project as an educational opportunity to teach his son about physics and mathematics throughout the construction process. Neighbors became curious and followed the project as it progressed in their backyard.
title: California dad spent $3,500 building 180-foot backyard roller coaster for son

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Serena Williams has taken an admirable step towards education by contributing to the Salt Marsh Basic School in Trelawny, Jamaica. This school provides free preschool education to local children, significantly improving their access to learning. By physically participating in the building process alongside other volunteers, Williams showcased the value of community collaboration in fostering educational growth and ensuring a safe space for the children.
title: Serena Williams helped build Jamaica school giving free education to 80 kids

author: RAJEEV SINGH
description: The movement began in the Paris region in mid-September, when high-school students and teachers protested over a lack of resources and staff. It quickly spread across France, with students blocking school entrances and later joined by university students, parents and trade unions. Their complaints include overcrowded classrooms, teachers not being replaced when absent, long school hours, deteriorating buildings and inequalities between schools in wealthier and poorer areas.
title: From France to Italy, Belgium to Greece, student protests spread across Europe

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: India's airlines are set to implement higher fuel surcharges for both domestic and international routes, starting October 9. Air India and Air India Express will adjust their fees in light of escalating global oil prices. Meanwhile, Akasa Air is reintroducing surcharges on its domestic flights, which will now range from Rs 375 to Rs 1,150, depending on flight distance. Increased surcharges will also apply to international flights, varying by destination.
title: Air India, AI Express hike fuel surcharge amid rising costs; Akasa Air reinstates levy

author: PRIYANKA MUKHERJEE
description: Before the Indian Air Force took its first flight in 1933, a lesser-known chapter of its history was already taking shape. The story of the Hawai Sepoys goes back to the early years of the force, when finding and training skilled personnel was among its first challenges. Their journey offers a glimpse into how the IAF's foundations were laid.
title: How IAF's first Hawai Sepoys came into being: Their story dates back to 1932

author: SMRITI JAIN
description: The GST Council approved a series of changes aimed at easing compliance, including removing the power of tax officials to make arrests and raising the prosecution threshold fivefold to Rs 5 crore. FM Nirmala Sitharaman said the GST Council had largely dealt with anomalies arising from input tax credit (ITC) and addressed the issue of duty inversion.
title: GST Reforms: Arrest powers scrapped, refunds automated; businesses set to see faster relief

author: PRANJAL PANDEY
description: Pakistan's defence forces chief Asim Munir has confirmed plans to deploy additional troops to Saudi Arabia. This deployment comes despite the country's parliament deciding against involvement in the Houthi conflict previously. The decision follows a recently signed Mecca defence pact between Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkey. Furthermore, Munir's increasing power and influence within the Pakistani political landscape are noteworthy.
title: Munir overrules Pak PM, to deploy more military assets to Riyadh under Mecca pact

author: SMRITI JAIN
description: Three H-1B related changes are stacking on top of each other: the multiple $100,000 fee proposals, the wage-weighted lottery favoring more senior workers, new layoff and compliance scrutiny, and now the OPT/STEM-OPT $70,000 fee proposal for students looking to work in the US. The pathway is set to become much narrower or worse may even disappear!
title: 'Death by restriction': As Trump sours H-1B visa dream, who faces biggest hit?

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Abhishek Agarwal, a Mumbai-based CEO, completed a 90-hour fast to celebrate his birthday. This personal challenge was aimed at pushing his limits and testing his discipline. The experience transitioned from a physical test to a mental one as the days progressed. Responses to his LinkedIn post ranged from admiration to caution about prolonged fasting. The conversation sparked online includes reflections on personal limits and endurance.
title: Mumbai CEO marks birthday with 90-hour fast, says he felt stronger

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said "Nvidia was founded because of Windows" during a conversation with Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella at Microsoft's Windows and Surface event in San Francisco. Huang credited Windows 95 and DirectX for Nvidia's early growth, while Nadella joked about a market cap transfer. The duo also pitched new RTX Spark PCs, including Microsoft's Surface Laptop Ultra, which start shipping on October 16.
title: Why Jensen Huang says Nvidia wouldn't exist without Microsoft, and CEO Nadella's reply

author: RAJEEV SINGH
description: On July 20, the protesters, gathered on the appeal of the CJP, were marching towards Parliament when the situation turned tensed as demonstrators attempted to move towards Parliament and breach police barricades in central Delhi, security personnel used tear gas and lathi-charge to disperse the protesters. Several videos subsequently circulated on social media, purportedly showing protesters being manhandled by police personnel, leading to allegations of excessive use of force.
title: Delhi Police crime branch to probe July 20 CJP protest violence; FIR registered

author: TANUJ LAKHINA
description: On October 13, officials from the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports will evaluate India's performance at the Asian Games. The nation secured far fewer medals than in previous tournaments, prompting a detailed review of financial allocations and the performance of seasoned athletes who fell short of expectations. Additionally, the existence of injuries before the Games has raised questions about the overall fairness of the competing teams.
title: Sports ministry, federations to review Asian Games performance on October 13

author: ANJALI SINGH
description: A 17-year-old rented an Audi for a friend's birthday celebration and caused a serious accident. The incident occurred around 2.30am on October 4 in Kishangarh. The driver allegedly crashed into three vehicles, resulting in the death of a pedestrian. Police apprehended the juvenile and registered an FIR related to his reckless driving. Investigators are also looking into the rental company's processes for verifying the driver's age and documents.
title: 17-year-old rents Audi crashes into 3 vehicles in Delhi, kills pedestrian

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Sumeet Raghavan took a trip to the picturesque Tattapani hot springs with a team from Indus Paragliding School. While enjoying the natural beauty, they made a positive impact by picking up litter along the trail. Sharing their efforts on Instagram, Raghavan voiced his concerns over the increasing pollution and urged the Himachal Pradesh government to enforce stricter cleanliness measures.
title: Sumeet Raghavan calls out tourists for littering during Himachal trip

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: The acquisition of Pulgamurtie Station in New South Wales, covering 74,000 hectares of unique landscapes, aims to protect the area's stunning pink lakes and vulnerable wildlife. This initiative not only prioritizes Aboriginal cultural heritage but also fosters diverse ecosystems vital for local species. Future plans include opportunities for recreational activities like birdwatching and scenic drives, supporting Australia's goal to expand protected areas.

Complete with a luxurious main residence and an underground shelter, the estate also boasted a well-stocked pond.
title: John Paul DeJoria turned 96-acre Texas ranch into home for 120 exotic animals

Congress leaders accused the government and Election Commission of undermining democratic rights and engaging in a conspiracy. Rahul Gandhi emphasized the need for justice regarding these electoral issues.

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: In a remarkable advancement, Stanford researchers have unveiled Orca-T therapy, which has recently received FDA approval. After two decades of rigorous development, this innovative treatment was administered to its inaugural commercial patient, a high-risk leukemia sufferer. Notably, Orca-T significantly minimizes the chances of graft-versus-host disease post-stem cell transplants, offering reduced chemotherapy requirements and lower side effects. Future studies are anticipated to investigate its relevance for broader patient demographics.
title: Stanford blood cancer transplant therapy reaches first commercial patient

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Research indicates that higher verbal intelligence can result in greater rumination and worry after experiencing negative emotions. While intelligent individuals may analyze their feelings in multiple dimensions, this can sometimes lead to excessive repetitive thinking. Reflection can lead to understanding, but when it evolves into rumination, it may create confusion. Moreover, cognitive processing does not guarantee emotional regulation, creating challenges in dealing with emotions.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A DoorDash driver in Maryland, US, survived a serious crash after his car's brakes failed during a delivery. Despite the accident, he told his customer where to collect the food. The customer's video of the unusual pickup went viral, drawing attention to the driver's financial difficulties. An online fundraiser later raised over $16,000 to help him recover.
title: DoorDash driver crashes during delivery; fundraiser later tops $15,000

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: Tata Consultancy Services has reported a notable 15% surge in net profit for the September quarter, achieving Rs 13,884 crore. The operations revenue grew by 11.22% year-on-year, hitting Rs 73,188 crore. AI revenue also surpassed $3 billion, contributing over 10% to the total income. With 4,258 new hires, TCS's workforce now stands at 5,98,056 and an attrition rate of 13.3%.
title: TCS Q2 results: Net profit rises 15% to Rs 13,884 crore, revenue up 11%

author: RAJEEV SINGH
description: Created in 1945 after two devastating world wars, the United Nations was designed to prevent another global catastrophe, provide a forum where countries could resolve disputes and give weaker countries a voice in an international system. The global platform once strongly voiced in the support of decolonisation, delivered humanitarian assistance, facilitated peace operations and provided a platform where even the smallest countries can speak is under immense strain.
title: UN-doing the United Nations: Can its next chief fix a system under strain?

author: AYUSH PANDEY
title: Canadian author Anne Carson awarded 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: LinkedIn co-founder Reid Hoffman has revealed how the company's early employees worked: home for dinner with family, then back on their laptops. Hoffman, who has long argued that work-life balance is not part of the startup game, says founders seeking balance aren't committed to winning. His view has drawn sharp pushback from founders including Jason Fried and Netflix co-founder Marc Randolph, who argue balance is part of success.
title: Reid Hoffman's LinkedIn rule: Dinner at home with family, then open the laptop again

author: ROHITASHWA RANJAN
title: The backstory: When Che Guevara failed to bring revolution to Bolivia after Cuba

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: The GST Council made a landmark decision by abolishing the arrest powers of tax officers. They've raised the prosecution threshold from Rs 1 crore to Rs 5 crore, easing the pressure on small sellers using e-commerce platforms. Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman announced that notices under Rs 10,000 will no longer be issued, aimed at promoting better GST compliance and alleviating burdens on small businesses.
title: GST Council scraps tax officers' arrest powers; prosecution threshold raised to Rs 5 cr

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Nana Patekar passed away on October 8 in Goa and his final rites will take place in Pune. His mortal remains are expected to arrive at Pune airport later in the evening. Authorities are preparing for increased traffic congestion due to VIP movement and mourners gathering at the farmhouse in Donaje. The traffic plan aims to ensure smooth movement for both the funeral procession and regular commuters.
title: Nana Patekar last rites: Mortal remains to reach Pune, state funeral likely by 10pm

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: India is experiencing impressive GDP growth of 7.8%, while the World Bank revises its growth outlook to 7.1%. Yet, Dalal Street faces turbulence as benchmark indices suffer losses exceeding 1%. This is largely due to foreign investors offloading shares and rising bond yields globally, fostering a cautious sentiment in the market.
title: India's GDP is booming, but stock market is crashing: What's going on?

author: SAURABH THAKUR
description: A district consumer commission in Uttar Pradesh found Apple India liable for a defective iPhone incident. The phone burst in a consumer’s pocket, injuring his thumb and damaging his personal photos. Following medical treatment, the commission ordered compensation for the consumer’s treatment expenses and directed a refund or replacement. Apple and the local seller failed to dispute the claims presented during the hearings.
title: iPhone burst in pocket, injured thumb; court orders Apple to replace it, pay Rs 36,139

author: KANCHAN YADAV
title: 'Have not come here for regime change': Dhruv Rathee during CJP protest in Bengaluru

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: Union minister Ashwini Vaishnaw announced plans for a Consultation paper on AI regulations to address specific concerns. The focus will include AI safety, deepfakes, user harm, and the need for skilling. The government aims to establish a regulatory framework while involving various stakeholders in the process. This initiative follows recent amendments in IT Rules to combat AI-generated harmful content more effectively.
title: AI regulation consultation paper next month, says IT minister Vaishnaw

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Kiara Advani and Sidharth Malhotra took to social media to announce the joyous news of expecting their second child. Since welcoming their daughter Saraayah in July 2025, Kiara has embraced motherhood, reflecting on the profound changes it has brought to her life. She highlights the necessity of self-care and boundaries while nurturing new life, expressing immense gratitude and excitement as they embark on this next adventure together.
title: Kiara Advani says motherhood changed her identity and parenting priorities

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: Dr. Phil and his wife Robin McGraw are parting ways with their opulent Beverly Hills estate, listed for a staggering $67.5 million. Acquired for $29.8 million in 2010, the couple undertook extensive renovations, culminating in a dream home featuring eight luxurious bedrooms, a swimming pool, and a guesthouse. This significant increase in value mirrors the thriving real estate market trends in the prestigious Beverly Hills neighborhood.
title: Dr Phil’s Beverly Hills mansion bought for $29.8m now lists for $67.5m

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A Nebraska farmer leases a 160-acre parcel for a wind turbine that occupies just one acre, leaving the remaining land available for farming. According to a 2021 NRECA case study, developer Bluestem Energy Solutions says a typical 30-year lease averages $10,000 to $12,500 annually, compared with an estimated $600 from growing corn on the same acre.
title: Nebraska wind turbine lease pays up to $12,500 a year for about 1 acre

author: AYUSH PANDEY
title: Govt caps trade margins on non-scheduled anti-cancer drugs at 30% of MRP

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: In December, the US Army will introduce the M8 carbine, a new weapon designed for improved soldier mobility. This carbine addresses feedback regarding the cumbersome nature of the M7 rifle; it is about a pound lighter and features a shorter barrel. Sig Sauer states that the M8 will offer enhanced performance while maintaining compatibility with the existing 6.8mm ammunition system, equipping soldiers with advanced capabilities.
title: 3 years, 50,000 rifles later: Why US Army is moving on from the M7

author: DHRUV YADAV
description: Raised on 8 October 1932, the Indian Air Force began with four Westland Wapiti biplanes and five Indian pilots at Drigh Road, Karachi. Today it is the world's fourth-largest air force, operating fighters such as the Su-30MKI, Rafale and Tejas, though it fields around 29 fighter squadrons against a sanctioned 42. Its combat record spans the Second World War, the wars of 1947-48, 1965 and 1971, Kargil, Balakot and Operation Sindoor. The force is now evolving into a networked aerospace power, built around the Integrated Air Command and Control System, growing unmanned capabilities and long-range airlift. That reach extends to multinational exercises such as Tarang Shakti and humanitarian missions as far afield as Venezuela, underlining its expanding strategic role.
title: The skies have changed, so has IAF's mission: 94 years of India's air power

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: Cornelia and Richard Thornburgh have successfully sold their prestigious lakefront mansion on Everglades Island for an impressive $25.4 million. Initially priced at $24.9 million, the property saw multiple price adjustments before finding a buyer. Acquired by the couple in 2014 for $9 million, they invested significantly in renovations. Following this lucrative sale, they opted for a cozy historic bungalow on Australian Avenue, purchased for $8.12 million.
title: Palm Beach couple bought waterfront home for $9m, later sold it for $25.4m

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: Prince William’s foundation funds Cornwall homes for 16 people facing homelessness

author: AYUSH PANDEY
title: 'Criminal conspiracy to hijack India': Rahul ups the ante against govt, CEC

author: AYUSH PANDEY
title: One missed email: How China got hold of sensitive US F-35 stealth fighter parts

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: The increasing age of COBOL engineers poses significant risks for the maintenance of legacy financial systems. Fewer young developers are learning COBOL, creating a shortage of skilled professionals. Transitioning away from COBOL is complex and carries substantial risks due to the systems' size and architecture. Some organizations are compensating COBOL expertise with high salaries, yet the long-term outlook remains concerning.
title: ATM’s ‘dying technology’ problem may hit data centres as engineers ‘disappear’

author: PRISHA PATNAIK
title: Stun grenades, severed hand: France's student protests put police under scrutiny

author: RAJEEV SINGH
description: Veterans said that "criticism of institutions is a democratic right. Denigration is not". They also hit out at the Congress party, which has double-down its verbal assault on Gyanesh Kumar, by questioning how the party's victory through the same EVM goes unquestioned. The ex-service members also highlighted how ECI's demand for sworn declaration was not submitted by the Lok Sabha leader of opposition Rahul Gandhi.
title: 'Campaign driven by political interests': 43 ex-judges back CEC in open letter

author: PRIYANKA JAISWAL
title: Plea in SC challenges appointment of CEC Gyanesh Kumar, two election commissioners

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Malaysia is undertaking an ambitious land reclamation project in Penang, aiming to establish a cutting-edge semiconductor hub named Silicon Island. This initiative is projected to attract substantial investments and create thousands of job opportunities by 2050. The project will diversify into multiple industrial functions, moving past mere chip assembly and testing.
title: Malaysia bets on AI boom with 2,300-acre Silicon Island

author: DHRUV YADAV
description: The Indian Army has placed an order for 225 First-Person View drones for their operations. These drones were tested under demanding high-altitude conditions to ensure performance and reliability. As tensions along the Line of Actual Control and the Line of Control persist, drone capabilities become increasingly vital. The Army focuses on indigenous manufacturing to meet its specific operational requirements.
title: 17,500 feet and counting: How Army is betting on FPV drones in the Himalayas

author: KANCHAN YADAV
title: 'Unacceptable': India condemns Houthis attack on Riyadh airports

author: PRISHA PATNAIK
title: Sri Lanka's former first lady arrested over alleged misuse of hospital funds

author: PRIYA SRIVASTAVA
description: Kavita Kumari, a resilient widow from Jharkhand, took up running to find a promising job for her children after her husband’s passing. Battling financial hardships, she juggled multiple jobs and utilized online resources to train for a Home Guard position. Her remarkable run in a saree captured national attention, rallying community support that provided her the necessary training equipment to enhance her chances in the selection process.
title: Meet Kavita Kumari, 27, who ran 1,600 metres barefoot in saree for Home Guard dream

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In an innovative leap in 2017, Cumbria began pioneering roads constructed from waste plastic, replacing traditional materials like bitumen. This initiative saw around 500,000 plastic bottles being repurposed, emphasizing sustainability while improving road resilience. As of 2021, trials demonstrated success, reflecting a promising future for eco-friendly road technology. Cumbria is actively expanding this project to broaden its positive environmental impact.
title: Cumbria road reused 500,000 plastic bottles; trial later deemed successful

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: Seven new bullet train corridors in works: In the coming years, Indian Railways is looking to make that a reality with seven new bullet train corridors in the works. Bullet trains typically operate at speeds of around 300 kmph, while some definitions of high-speed rail cover services operating at around 220-250 kmph.
title: Mumbai-Pune in 48 min, Delhi-Varanasi under 4 hours: 7 bullet train routes

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In 2016, Jon Stewart and Tracey Stewart acquired Hockhockson Farm in Colts Neck, New Jersey, with the vision of establishing both a working farm and a sanctuary for rescued farm animals. Their ambitious plans include educational programs focused on sustainable farming and healthy eating. The property is equipped with barns and pastures, as well as facilities dedicated to animal care, successfully fulfilling its mission of promoting agriculture and welfare.
title: Jon Stewart and wife turned 45-acre New Jersey farm into animal sanctuary

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: In 2023, when India played New Zealand in a T20I at the same venue, Ajit Agarkar did the pitch report before the match. As part of the broadcast coverage, Agarkar assessed the playing conditions and pointed out the dimensions of the ground, the grass cover and the possible impact of dew.
title: India vs West Indies in Ranchi brings back an Ajit Agarkar memory

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Michael and Susan Dell urged parents to claim funds in newly established 'Trump Accounts' for children. These accounts, created under a new federal tax law, aim to provide children with financial advantages. Eligible American children can receive a one-time contribution to encourage future investments. The Dells have committed over $6 billion to support these accounts for the next generation.
title: After $6.25B 'gift' to Trump Accounts, Michael Dell's wife makes an 'appeal' to parents

author: DHRUV YADAV
description: The Indian Air Force marked its 94th anniversary, emphasizing its growth since 1932. Air Chief highlighted the significance of training and readiness, as showcased in various exercises this year. Technologies such as artificial intelligence and autonomous systems are shaping modern warfare and enhancing decision-making. The IAF's self-reliance strategy promotes development of indigenous aircraft and missile systems. Coordination between the IAF, Army, and Navy is increasing, demonstrating integration in national defense.
title: At 94, Indian Air Force is looking beyond fighter jets: What comes next

author: NITESH DUBEY
description: At 36, Bhuvneshwar Kumar is back in India’s T20I setup, four years after his last international appearance. His recall followed a 28-wicket IPL season for RCB and a strong UP T20 campaign, but the numbers tell only part of the story. His strength and conditioning coach reveals how Bhuvneshwar cut his body fat from 19% to 14%, spent up to seven hours a day training and rebuilt his fitness to force his way back.
title: Six hours a day, 19% to 14% body fat: Inside Bhuvneshwar Kumar’s bid for longevity at 36

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Jamie Dimon has highlighted the need for data centre developers to select states that are supportive of AI infrastructure initiatives. He emphasized the necessity for adequate electricity capacity in these locations. Dimon also pointed out the escalating cybersecurity threats linked to sophisticated AI models, such as Anthropic's Mythos. It is essential for companies to manage these emerging vulnerabilities proactively instead of reacting in panic.
title: JP Morgan CEO has a 'suggestion' for companies building datacenters in America

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
title: Arizona’s leopard frogs show signs of recovery across 19 sites by 2019

author: SAURABH THAKUR
description: In a decisive ruling, a Delhi consumer commission has mandated an air conditioner manufacturer to replace a faulty unit after a consumer's Voltas AC proved defective shortly after its July 2024 purchase. The manufacturer and seller must also pay Rs 15,000 for inadequate service, compensating for not only the malfunction but also the consumer's mental distress and allowing for interest on the outstanding amounts.
title: AC kept malfunctioning; Delhi consumer court orders replacement with Rs 15,000

author: PRASAD SANYAL
description: On the occasion of its 94th anniversary, the Indian Air Force faces significant scrutiny regarding its reduced combat readiness. Currently operating with merely 30 fighter squadrons instead of the authorized 42, questions about its capacity to effectively deter potential threats are becoming increasingly concerning.
title: IAF at 94: Capable, but stretched

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Virat Kohli expressed his condolences on social media after Nana Patekar's death due to cardiac arrest. Patekar was a prominent figure in Hindi and Marathi cinema, earning numerous accolades throughout his career. He made his mark with roles in films like Parinda and Prahar, and was awarded the Padma Shri in 2013. His recent works included Housefull 5 and O’Romeo, showcasing his enduring talent in the industry.
title: ‘True legend of Indian cinema’: Virat Kohli mourns Nana Patekar

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In an astonishing discovery, a seemingly unremarkable painting by David Bowie was acquired for just C$5 at a South River donation center. Once authenticated as DHead XLVI, the artwork soared to a staggering auction price of C$108,120. Experts linked it to Bowie's 1990s oeuvre, showcasing how opportunistic collectors can miss hidden treasures without knowledge of their past.
title: Shopper paid C$5 for painting; David Bowie original later sold for C$108,120

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A 2,600-acre timber property in South Carolina, near the rivers where Revolutionary War commander Francis Marion hid from British forces, has been transferred to the state for conservation. The land forms part of a 7,600-acre project covering more than 60 miles of riverfront, aimed at protecting historic sites, wildlife habitats and floodplains that help reduce flooding.
title: South Carolina adds 2,600 acres to conservation project with 60 miles of riverfront

author: TNN
description: A rat was allegedly found in a masala dosa at a Borivli hotel by two sisters. They reportedly demanded Rs 25 lakh as compensation after the incident. The hotelier paid them Rs 1 lakh but later received continued demands from them. As a result, the hotelier approached the police for assistance. An FIR has since been registered against the sisters for extortion.
title: Rat in dosa, Rs 25L demand: How complaint against Mumbai hotel took an extortion turn

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Amazon has launched another round of job cuts, mainly affecting its Stores division and other teams. This comes on the heels of a significant restructuring that resulted in around 30,000 layoffs last year. Business Insider reported that less than 1,000 white-collar positions were impacted. Leadership underscored the necessity to realign priorities, aligning with its ongoing commitment to strategic enhancements as the tech landscape evolves.
title: Amazon makes fresh job cuts, here's what messages from internal Slack groups 'tell'

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Lionel Messi concluded his international career with a farewell match where he scored and assisted in a victory. Cristiano Ronaldo, his rival, honored Messi's achievements and expressed his respect in a social media post. More than 85,000 fans attended the match at Buenos Aires’ Monumental Stadium, celebrating Messi's legacy. Messi reflected on his 21-year journey representing Argentina and the emotions tied to his decision.
title: ‘History that'll last forever’: Ronaldo pays tribute to Messi with ‘utmost respect’

author: SMRITI JAIN
description: MDR on UPI: Last month, the government ended the zero-fee regime for UPI by allowing merchants to be charged 0.4% on transactions above Rs 2,000. UPI is used by more than 500 million people across the country for payments ranging from roadside cups of tea to iPhones. The charge  is scheduled to take effect on October 15, coinciding with the annual festive season.
title: Govt may delay rollout of MDR on UPI transactions above Rs 2,000: Report

author: SMRITI JAIN
description: Stock market crash today:  At 1:25 PM, Nifty50 was trading at 22,260.70, down 342 points or 1.51%. BSE Sensex was at 71,670.06, down 968 points or 1.33%. Sustained selling in large-caps by the FIIs have contributed significantly to this trend. With the US 10-year bond yield hovering above 5.3%, FIIs will continue to sell on every rally.
title: Sensex tanks over 1,000 points, Rs 8.5 lakh crore wiped out: Top reasons behind market rout

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Jason and Kylie Kelce proudly hosted their third annual Underdog Golf Outing, raising an impressive $553,500 for their Be Philly Foundation, dedicated to supporting underserved children in Philadelphia. This successful event saw 96 participants, including several notable former athletes, effectively blending sports and charitable efforts. Looking ahead, Be Philly aims to amplify its influence, targeting the distribution of over $1 million in 2026 to empower the youth of Philadelphia.
title: Jason and Kylie Kelce's $553,500 charity effort helps kids through Be Philly

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: East Hampton Town plans to acquire 38.3 acres of a former sand mine in Wainscott for $36.3 million. The purchase aims to preserve the land for parks and open space, reserving a smaller section for municipal needs. This decision marks a significant change from prior contentious commercial development proposals in the area. A public hearing is set for October 15 to allow residents to voice their opinions.
title: East Hampton plans $36.3m buy of former sand mine to preserve 33.3 acres

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: Nevada’s historic Shakespeare Ranch, first listed for $188 million in 2024, is now asking $125 million after failing to find a buyer. The 700-acre Lake Tahoe estate features multiple homes, a 465-foot private pier and a barn built in 1873. Despite strong demand for luxury waterfront properties in the region, the ranch remains unsold.
title: Nevada’s 700-acre Shakespeare Ranch cuts asking price from $188m to $125m

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: BJP leaders escalated attacks on Rahul Gandhi following his protests against the Election Commission. C R Kesavan accused Gandhi of inappropriate behavior toward a female police officer during the protest. Nitin Nabin labeled Gandhi as having an anarchist mindset and suggested he resign if he disagrees with the Election Commission. The Congress party has expressed demands for Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation over recent decisions.
title: BJP turns heat on Rahul Gandhi over 'clash' with female Delhi cop

author: PRISHA PATNAIK
title: ‘Iran will never have a nuclear weapon’: Rubio draws red line for Tehran

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: Reports indicate that Russia is looking to reestablish gas supplies via the Nord Stream pipelines by negotiating with US investors, including Jared Kushner and a Russian adviser to Putin. This effort faces formidable challenges due to existing US and EU sanctions. Germany has taken a hard line against restoring gas imports while evaluating its military readiness regarding Russia. Additionally, the complexities surrounding gas ownership could impede any potential agreements.
title: Russia eyes return to Europe's gas market despite sanctions, Ukraine war: Report

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: The ITAT Chennai bench viewed the increase from Rs 3 lakh to Rs 25 lakh as an enhancement of an existing benefit, rather than the creation of a new exemption. The Tribunal also found the change beneficial and remedial in nature and said it was intended to reduce hardship and bring parity between government and non-government employees.
title: Man gets leave encashment tax benefit, but limit hiked later; ITAT allows Rs 12.27L

author: KANCHAN YADAV
title: 'Not bragging': Trump makes fresh pitch for Nobel Peace Prize, citing '8 settled wars'

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan's nonprofit Biohub has secured fresh funding from Google DeepMind, Meta, Isomorphic Labs and the US government to build a "virtual cell", an AI model that predicts how human cells respond to disease and treatment. Total investment in the Virtual Biology Initiative now stands at $1.8 billion. Biohub expects its first open dataset in about a year, with accurate predictive models within the next five years.
title: Mark Zuckerberg’s Biohub gets millions from Google, US govt to build virtual cells

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi is making waves in the cricket world with his remarkable feats at an early age. However, cricket legend Kapil Dev advocates caution, emphasizing the volatile nature of youth talent. He stresses the significance of a player's growth beyond the cricket field for long-term success. In essence, the key question remains whether Sooryavanshi can sustain his performance consistently over the years.
title: ‘So many have faded out’: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi cautioned with Vinod Kambli example

author: PRIYANKA JAISWAL
title: ‘Slap’ row: Delhi HC seeks Parvesh Verma, police response on plea for independent probe

author: NIDA SAYED
description: Actor Nana Patekar was declared dead after being brought to Manipal Hospital in Goa. He sent a message to a friend indicating he was unwell before losing consciousness. Friends and a caretaker accompanied him when he was taken to the hospital. Medical staff attempted to revive him for nearly an hour but declared him dead upon arrival. His body has been sent for a post-mortem examination following a medico-legal case.
title: Nana Patekar's late-night message & what doctors revealed about hours that followed

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Syria is considering military support for Saudi Arabia amid increased Houthi attacks on the kingdom. Discussions include potentially deploying troops as well as providing defensive expertise to combat the Houthi threat. Recent years have seen a strengthening of relations between Syria and Saudi Arabia, with new economic agreements established. However, Syria's priority remains its own recovery from a prolonged civil war.
title: Syria considers sending troops to Saudi Arabia to fight Houthis

author: ABHISHEK MISHRA
title: ‘Few actors possessed his intensity’: Top leaders mourn Nana Patekar

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: The rupee opened at 96.71 against the dollar but improved to 96.65 thanks to intervention from the Reserve Bank of India. External factors, like a robust US dollar and climbing crude oil prices, are still putting pressure on the currency. Additionally, India's forex reserves are diminishing, leading to unease about the rupee's consistency.
title: Rupee rises 10 paise against US dollar: What is supporting the currency?

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: On October 8, the Indian Air Force marked its 94th anniversary, showcasing the unwavering commitment of its air warriors. In a ceremonial salute, President Droupadi Murmu and Prime Minister Narendra Modi paid tribute to their bravery and expertise that ensure the safety of the nation. Since its inception, the IAF has progressed notably, enhancing its strategic capabilities and modernizing its aircraft.
title: President Murmu, PM Modi hail IAF on Air Force Day

author: SAURABH THAKUR
description: The Allahabad High Court made significant rulings on a property conflict in Muzaffarnagar concerning enemy and evacuee claims. The court determined that the state lacked substantial evidence to support its claims and highlighted the dismissal of prior complaints regarding the property. Consequently, it prohibited state officials from halting construction based on the approved map, thereby safeguarding the petitioners' property rights and ability to build.
title: What is ‘enemy property’ and how is it identified? Allahabad high court explains

title: 'No excuse for victim blaming': Mamdani under fire from Democrats over Oct 7 message

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Over the last 36 years, North Carolina's coastal forests have seen a dramatic decrease in forest cover. The decline sped up after 2010 due to rising sea levels and increased salinity. The research revealed a troubling shift, with once green areas transforming into marshes, shrubs, or ghost forests. Moreover, extreme weather events have intensified the threat of saltwater intrusion, making these forests increasingly vulnerable.
title: North Carolina lost 21% of coastal forests in just 36 years

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Following six generations of dedication, Holly Hill Farm has successfully been secured as an active agricultural hub in Massachusetts. The Friends of Holly Hill Farm raised over $4.9 million, allowing them to purchase and maintain the site. The nonprofit will run the farm with a focus on facility improvements and community engagement, providing educational resources to 20,000 students each year and donating produce to local food banks.
title: Massachusetts family farm protected after $4.9 million rescue

author: HADI KHAN
description: Saurav Das attempted to draw Shashi Tharoor into discussing Prime Minister Narendra Modi's recent temple visit. Tharoor responded ambiguously, requesting clarification regarding the controversial metaphor he previously used. This interaction occurred against a backdrop of political tensions surrounding electoral roll revisions in Delhi. Opposition leaders, including Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi Vadra, were detained while protesting.
title: How Shashi Tharoor left CJP's Saurav Das without a sting in the tail

author: NIDA SAYED
description: Nana Patekar died from a cardiac arrest shortly after an event in Goa, where he emphasized life's uncertainties. He encouraged attendees to serve others and live fully, stating that nothing is taken after death. Patekar was a prominent figure in theatre and cinema, recognized for his impactful performances in Hindi and Marathi films. Following his death, tributes poured in from across the country, highlighting his contributions to the arts.
title: 'Who knows about tomorrow': Nana Patekar's words at last public appearance

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Haidlmair recently celebrated its largest Amazon order with an elaborate party in Upper Austria. A Bezos impersonator arrived via helicopter, accompanied by actual police officers. The involvement of a special police unit has sparked controversy regarding their presence at the event. Reports indicate that the police may have been compensated for their time during this unusual assignment.
title: A billionaire's Amazon celebration becomes a scandal in Austria, reaches Parliament

author: ABHISHEK MISHRA
title: ‘Alert, ready’: IAF chief hails force’s combat speed during Operation Sindoor

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Hardik Pandya's long absence from competitive cricket emphasizes ongoing concerns regarding player workload and fitness issues. Despite working towards a return, his recurring shin issue has delayed his comeback plans. Other players, including Prasidh Krishna and Harshit Rana, are also facing injury challenges affecting their participation. Former captain Kapil Dev pointed out the importance of playing regularly to maintain fitness levels.

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Travis Kelce’s mom Donna Kelce helped turn her famous family cookie recipe into a charity fundraiser for Kansas schoolchildren. After small-business owner Annie Stowe received permission to print the recipe on handmade mugs, $5 from each sale went towards paying elementary school lunch debt. The mugs initially raised $2,000 in 2023, followed by another $2,100 after local coverage, bringing the total to $4,100.
title: Travis Kelce’s mom Donna Kelce helps raise $4,100 for students’ lunch debt

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: A remorseful inmate at Sabarmati Central Jail shares his heartfelt regret over a crime fueled by anger. He realizes the emotional burden his actions have placed on his family, particularly his two daughters and elderly parents. As one daughter gears up for college, the other faces lifelong challenges that require ongoing support.
title: 'I regret it': Sabarmati inmate breaks down, says he killed in anger

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: In a significant move, HubSpot, a leading technology firm based in the UK, will cut around 660 jobs as part of a strategic overhaul to better integrate AI advancements. CEO Yamini Rangan discussed three pivotal changes aimed at improving customer experiences and optimizing management. Employees losing their positions will be provided with severance and support during the transition, highlighting a shift in the company’s focus and strategies.
title: HubSpot, one of the UK's biggest technology companies, is cutting hundreds of jobs

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: Bhuvneshwar Kumar’s return to the Indian team after a four-year gap has raised the possibility of another experienced pacer making his way back into the squad. Former India batter Wasim Jaffer believes Mohammed Shami deserves that opportunity, particularly in Test cricket. Shami has produced strong performances since returning from a long injury lay-off and has remained among the wickets across formats.
title: 'If Shami is neglected, door will be closed': Ex-India star warns selectors
